turns.Question: Set the CCD exposure time to 0 s.
turns.Ans: The CCD exposure time cannot be set to 0 seconds, as the hardware requires a positive value for signal integration. The system returned an error indicating that the exposure time must be greater than 0.

Tool calls.name: set_ccd_exposure
Tool calls.error: Exposure time must be greater than 0.
